name: Skaven

factionAbilities.name: The Lurking Vermintide
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN unit that has not been deployed.
factionAbilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the tunnels below. It has now been deployed.

factionAbilities.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
factionAbilities.flavour: The best laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-MONSTER SKAVEN unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.
factionAbilities.effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

factionAbilities.name: Too Quick to Hit-Hit
factionAbilities.flavour: These skittish ratmen dart and run in all directions, avoiding retribution as they flee from combat.
factionAbilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY and CAVALRY units by RETREAT abilities.

factionAbilities.name: Splinters of the Vermindoom
factionAbilities.flavour: In the aftermath of the Vermindoom, reality continues to fracture and tear as gnawholes bore into reality, spewing forth endless tides of ratmen.
factionAbilities.declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly Gnawholes on the battlefield.
factionAbilities.effect: Set up a Gnawhole on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

factionAbilities.name: Gnawhole Ambush
factionAbilities.flavour: Emerging from a green, glowing rift, the Skaventide pours onto the battlefield.
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN unit that is in the tunnels below to use this ability.
factionAbilities.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Gnawhole and more than 9" from all enemy units.
